items.stem: Which goal is written in SMART form?

options.text: Get better at data analysis someday
options.rationale: It lacks a measure, a deadline and specificity.

options.text: Complete a certified SQL course and analyse two real datasets by 30 June
options.rationale: Correct: it is specific, measurable, time-bound and achievable.

options.text: Be the best analyst in the company
options.rationale: It is not specific or measurable and has no timeframe.
Vague and unmeasurable, with no deadline.

items.explanation: Correct: it is specific, measurable, time-bound and achievable.

items.stem: The strongest portfolio piece for a target role primarily shows:

options.text: A list of your job responsibilities
options.rationale: Duties describe activity, not the value you created.

options.text: A result you produced and the impact it had
options.rationale: Correct: evidence of outcomes and impact persuades far more than duties.

options.text: The number of years you have worked
options.rationale: Tenure alone does not demonstrate capability.

options.text: A full list of every tool you have touched
options.rationale: A tool list without results proves little about your value.

items.explanation: Correct: evidence of outcomes and impact persuades far more than duties.
